entities.title: zazzle invoker tests
entities.summary: The invoker's host unit tests with their mock syscall layer, the coverage gate and the end-to-end smoke test.
entities.purpose: unit.c checks the request logic in src/zazzle_core.h on the host, built with -DZAZZLE_TEST so that src/sys.h includes sys_mock.h (scripted syscall results, a fake clock and recorded effects) instead of a real backend; `make unit` runs it. coverage.sh reads gcov's report and fails below a branch threshold; `make coverage` runs it with 95. smoke.sh runs the real build/zazzle against a real zazzled (ZAZZLED, by default macos/rust/target/release/zazzled) on temporary sockets, and stand-ins for the standalone tools and for zazzled's run and proxy.
boundaries: What each test checks is recorded with the behaviour it checks, in macos/c/zazzle/src/.dev/verification.json.
smoke.sh needs zazzled built first; it starts and stops its own daemons and touches only a temporary directory.
